author: Ayo

title: Post Exhibition Relaxation
text:
It was a very relaxing and refreshing cruise; a much needed activity following 4 days of attending exhibitions and visiting clients. The nice thing about the cruise is the upper deck where you get to enjoy the sun and the cool breeze as the boat sails along the coast. 

I do wish that the cruise was a bit longer, I know that there are the 2 hour boat cruises but they were not available as frequent as the 1 hour cruise. I also wish that there was live commentary on the different points that we were passing by.
author: Faysal_A

title: Solid, competent, professional harbour tour
text: Excellent boat equipped with bar charging reasonable prices. Ticketing swift and straightforward. We boarded and pushed off precisely on time. Barcelona is a big port and in 60 minutes you don’t get far, but we cruised east along the beach, then back to the central port, and got to inspect cruise ships and plutocrats’ giant yachts up close. There is no commentary on guide. Nonetheless a good value and a lovely way to spend a little time at sundown.
author: Thomas_F
